zh.title: 新加坡永續航空燃料費 2027 年起適用，經濟艙每人 1 至 10.40 新幣
zh.summary: 亞太永續航空燃料論壇 11 月 23 日在新加坡登場。依新加坡民航局規定，2026 年 10 月起售出、2027 年元旦起由新加坡出發的旅程，將按目的地與艙等收取永續航空燃料費。
body: 亞洲永續航空燃料協會與 Sustainable Aviation Futures 於 11 月 23 日在新加坡舉辦 One Sky Policy Forum，邀請亞太地區民航、能源等領域的代表交流。新加坡民航局的政策目標是從 2027 年起將永續航空燃料（SAF）使用比例定為 1%，到 2030 年視全球供應與市場情況提高至 3% 至 5%。
旅客費用適用於 2026 年 10 月 1 日起售出、2027 年 1 月 1 日起由新加坡出發的機票，對象為以新加坡為旅程起點的旅客。依航程目的地與艙等，經濟艙及豪華經濟艙每人收取 1 至 10.40 新幣，商務艙及頭等艙每人收取 4 至 41.60 新幣。
通用航空和商務航空也從 2027 年起依機型大小與目的地按架次計費。航空貨運則從 2028 年起按貨重及目的地計費，適用於 2027 年 10 月 1 日起售出的服務。民航局表示，費用將納入基金，用於採購永續航空燃料、相關環境屬性及支付行政成本。

en.title: Singapore’s SAF levy starts in 2027, with economy fares charged S$1 to S$10.40
en.summary: Asia-Pacific aviation fuel policymakers met in Singapore on Nov. 23. Singapore’s aviation regulator will apply a sustainable aviation fuel levy to eligible journeys departing from the country from Jan. 1, 2027, with rates set by destination and cabin class.
body: The Asia Sustainable Aviation Fuel Association and Sustainable Aviation Futures held the One Sky Policy Forum in Singapore on Nov. 23. It brought together representatives from aviation, energy and other sectors across the region. Singapore’s Civil Aviation Authority has set a 1% sustainable aviation fuel (SAF) target for 2027 and aims to reach 3% to 5% by 2030, depending on global developments and supply.

The passenger levy applies to tickets sold from Oct. 1, 2026, for flights departing from Jan. 1, 2027, when Singapore is the origin of the journey. The rate is S$1 to S$10.40 per passenger in economy or premium economy and S$4 to S$41.60 in business or first class, depending on the destination band.

General and business aviation will also face a per-aircraft charge from 2027, based on aircraft size and destination. A per-kilogram cargo levy starts in 2028 for eligible services sold from Oct. 1, 2027. According to the regulator, a fund will use levy proceeds to buy SAF and its environmental attributes and cover administrative costs.

facts.claim: The One Sky Policy Forum was held in Singapore on Nov. 23.
Singapore targets 1% SAF from 2027 and 3% to 5% by 2030, depending on supply and global developments.
The levy applies to eligible departing passengers from Jan. 1, 2027, for tickets sold from Oct. 1, 2026.
Passenger rates range from S$1 to S$10.40 in economy cabins and S$4 to S$41.60 in premium cabins.
General and business aviation is charged from 2027; an eligible cargo charge begins in 2028.
The levy fund covers SAF, environmental attributes and administrative costs.
